title: God's love for Israel and the promise of restoration
description: God reminds how he loved Israel as a son and called him out of Egypt, teaching Ephraim to walk. But the people turned to Baal gods and idols, and judgment comes through Assyria. Yet God's heart turns in compassion: he will not destroy Ephraim, for he is God and not man. Finally, the people shall return trembling like birds from Egypt and doves from the land of Assyria, and the Lord will let them dwell in their homes.
